name: nemotron-3.5-swahili-streaming-asr
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (FastConformer-RNNT, cache-aware streaming), not a new base model: same config, same 0.6B parameters. Ships a .nemo archive plus ONNX exports (one int8, one fp32) rather than safetensors - the ONNX files are export artifacts of this same checkpoint, not separate quantized models, so this is not a repack. Recorded as a contender because it publishes WER/CER against its own base on the same streaming pipeline; rows are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other (NVIDIA open model licence), repo created 2026-06-05.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS sw_ke test WER % (streaming, [56,13])
benchmarks.config: Card '## Results — FLEURS sw_ke test (n=487, identical streaming pipeline, lowercase+punct-strip)' table: row '[56,13] (~480 ms)' 0.298 vs row 'base model [56,13] (no Swahili FT)' 1.147, same table/split. Card prints fractions; multiplied by 100 here. Base is ~100% WER with degenerate loop output, so the gap is floor-to-working rather than a like-for-like margin. Self-scored, no judge.

benchmarks.name: FLEURS sw_ke test CER % (streaming, [56,13])
benchmarks.config: Same table, CER column: this 0.106 vs base 0.860. Card caveat: formal 'Sanifu' Kenyan Swahili only, not Sheng; checkpoint is a weight soup of the 5 best checkpoints, each selected on this same held-out test set.
